worked_example.problem: Describe how {o} is made by the lost-wax method.
steps: Make a wax model and cover it with clay; heat it so the wax melts out, leaving a mould.
Pour molten bronze into the mould, let it cool, then break the clay.
worked_example.answer: Wax model, clay mould, wax melted out, metal poured in, clay broken off.
